notes.title: Ver1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
​[h2]Improvements[/h2]​​
[list]
[*]Increased the spawn rate of rare items
[*]Items that have reached the maximum carry limit will no longer appear in shops
[*]Locked items will no longer reappear when refreshing the shop
[*]Increased enemy health and damage in Endless Mode
[/list]

​​[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]​​
[list]
[*]Fixed bomb damage not scaling with floor progression
[*]Fixed some achievements not triggering in Endless Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Ver0.103 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Entering non-combat areas now increases corresponding stats.
[*]Improved the description of primary stats.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed camera movement stuttering during fast travel.
[*]Fixed untranslated text in the outfit customization interface.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Notes Ver0.102
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added random pitch variations to weapon sound effects.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed incorrect audio issues with kunai and boomerang.
[*] Resolved camp voice lines malfunction.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.101 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Maximum frame rate capped at 60 FPS (may not apply on high-refresh-rate displays due to VSync).
[*]Optimized audio implementation and added some missing sound effects.
[*]Increased font size in certain UI elements for better compatibility with Steam Deck.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed incorrect background music switching when returning to the main menu during gameplay.
[*]Fixed an issue where protective weapons were not hidden when the player was attacked by monsters.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.100 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Repulsion Orb's function has been adjusted to fire additional energy balls upon hitting a target.
[*]Dash now has a 1-second internal cooldown.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where some weapons' inherent effects would disappear after attacking.
[*]Fixed an issue where the font color became hard to read when the Faith Gauge was full.
[*]Fixed an issue where the damage bonus from "Frenzied Monsters" was calculated incorrectly.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.99 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]For performance optimization, picking up gems dropped by monsters will also grant money. Gold coins will only appear as additional drops.
[*]Overall balance adjustments to weapon stats.
[*]Increased the appearance rate of rarity 4 items in shops.
[*]Added rarity 1 versions for some weapons.
[*]Adjusted the starting weapons for certain classes.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed inconsistencies in some terminology.
[*]Fixed an issue where merchants in camps could be pushed away.
[*]Fixed an issue where switching characters in camp could prevent further construction.
[*]Fixed an issue where the attack speed bonus from agility did not work correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue where abnormal tooltips appeared when capturing monster info.
[*]Fixed a mismatch between cooldown values in weapon tooltips and actual values.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Holy Bow could not shoot.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.98 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Optimized the attack behavior of the bat.
[*]Improved the visual effects of projectiles fired by monsters during their frenzy state.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where some languages displayed incomplete text in the shrine upgrade options.
[*]Fixed an issue where location name text overflowed its frame.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes Ver 0.97
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Added a dash ability for characters. Use the ​Spacebar (keyboard) or the ​South Button (controller) to activate.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where the damage decay settings for ​Bouncing Caltrops and ​Slingshot were incorrect.
[*]Fixed incorrect descriptions for the ​Slingshot.
[*]Fixed an issue where the ​Goddess CG black screen effect would persist after exiting.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.96 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where girls were wearing clothes during farm extraction scenes.
[*]Fixed incorrect attribute restoration when agility-boosting food effects expired.
[*]Fixed inconsistent terminology in Russian localization.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.95 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Added Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.94 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]  
[olist]  
[*]Optimized the burning mechanic: Different weapons' burning effects can now stack on the same enemy.  
[*]Added a new trait for the Delinquent Girl class: Burning effects trigger immediately.  
[*]Changed the Explosive Kunai's attack behavior to a throwing motion and increased its range.  
[*]Increased the range of staff-type weapons.  
[*]E and Q keys are now also recognized as "Confirm" and "Cancel."  
[*]Adjusted the prices of certain weapons and items to match their rarity.  
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.93 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Added special effects to thrusting weapons.
[*]Exploding kunai now triggers only on critical hits, and its attack pattern has been modified.
[*]Item hover Tips now display quantity limit information.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed the issue where stamina recovery messages were not localized.
[*]Fixed missing Korean text.
[*]Fixed text overflow in some languages in the settings menu.
[*]Fixed the issue where Bunny Girl's absorption of hearts after battle did not increase desire.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.92 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Optimized boomerang special effects.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where continuously pressing confirm when entering the game could cause the game to freeze on the main menu.
[*]Fixed an issue where critical rate decimal values in weapon tips were too long.
[*]Fixed an issue where hearts absorbed after battle weren't affected by heart healing amount modifiers.
[*]Fixed an issue where Bunny Girl wouldn't gain Lust when absorbing hearts after battle.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.91 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]

notes.title: Ver0.90 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when departing from the camp in version 0.89.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.89 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Explosion effect range is divided into 2 types: Explosion Wand and Grenades have a range of 3, others 2.
[*] Increased staff weapon range and attribute modifiers.
[*] Office Lady's initial passive skill enhanced: Resistance now scales with level and money obtained. Added "Critical Rate increases with held Gold" feature.
[*] Weapon Critical Rate and Critical Multiplier now correctly display modified final values.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed issue where sound effect of monster capture food skill could not be controlled.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.88 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The tentacle attacks of the Giant Tentacle Monster can now trigger captures. It is easier to capture the Giant Tentacle Monster on Floor 16.
[*] Added a "Delete Save Data" function to the settings menu on the main screen.
[*] The VIP Card item now has an additional effect of increasing the number of monsters in heat on the field.
[*] When the player's clothes are completely torn, the spawn rate of monsters in heat will increase.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where explosion sound effects were not affected by settings. //It's really fixed this time Q_Q
[*] Fixed an issue where the effect of increasing the spawn rate of monsters in heat was not working.
[*] Fixed an issue where Slime Girls would turn red.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters would sometimes respawn during the results screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with effect clipping.
[*] Fixed an issue where Goblin Bombers' bombs could still deal damage during the results screen.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.87 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Optimized weapon swing animations.
[]*Increased melee weapon range.
[*]Added swing effects to weapons.
[*]Adjusted Explosive Orb effect: now bounces once before exploding on the final bounce.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where food skills were not being granted after cooking during adventures.
[/olist]

[*]After the 5th floor, even if the adventure fails, ​Monster Farm Essence will now be restored.

[olist]

notes.title: Ver0.85 Update Notes

[olist]

[olist]

notes.title: Ver0.82 Update Notes
notes.content:

[olist]
[*]Materials can now be stored and used immediately after obtaining them.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where the price increase for recycled items was not working.
[*]Fixed an issue with abnormal configuration and statistics in the Goddess quest.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Spike Challenge caused continuous damage.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.81 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustment [/h1]
[olist]
[*]The farm now has a new feature to increase corruption. Players can trigger it after each successful or failed adventure.
[*]Corruption will increase after each successful QTE, with even more gained upon final success. The more times a girl is violated by monsters, the more QTEs will be required.
[*]When gaining corruption on the farm, additional corruption will be awarded based on the number of monsters watching.
[*]All bow-type weapons now have piercing capabilities.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where players would move in reverse if their speed was below -100.
[*]Fixed an issue where items that increase bounce or piercing affected weapons that cannot bounce or pierce.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.80 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Optimized the detailed descriptions of piercing and bouncing weapons.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed the issue with incorrect damage calculation for piercing attenuation.
[*]Fixed the issue where pet collars did not display the corresponding appearance after being equipped.
[*]Fixed the issue where voice volume could not be adjusted.
[*]Fixed the issue where automatic weapon upgrades could cause confusion.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.79 Update Notes
notes.content:

[olist]
[*] The additional function of the Baby Hammer has been adjusted:
[list]

[*] An explosion is triggered on a critical hit.
[/list]
[*] Corresponding numerical effects are now increased each time you resist Battle H.
[*] Added interface display information when successfully resisting attribute changes.
[/olist]
[h1]​Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where entering an adventure after being defeated by H would cause the game to freeze during Battle H.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.77 Patch Note
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug where the UI is displayed in the initial event and the character can still move
2. Fixed the bug where the animation of the Piranha Plant causes the game process to get stuck

notes.title: Demo Bug Fix 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ​Revamped Attribute System: Introduced the Faith and Desire mechanics.
[*] ​Optimized Monster Configuration: Adjusted the enemy setup for Difficulty Level 1.
[*] ​Improved Hit Detection: Enhanced the hit detection for thrusting melee weapons.
[*] ​Added More Gameplay Information: The Esc menu now displays additional gameplay experience details.
[*] ​Fixed Experience and Gold Calculation: Resolved an issue where experience and gold were incorrectly calculated at the end of each floor.
[*] ​Fixed Fairy Effect Display: Corrected an issue where the fairy effect was displayed as purple.
[*] ​Fixed H-Related Freeze: Addressed a bug where the game would freeze after H interactions in town and with monsters.
[*] ​Fixed Weapon Attack Freeze: Resolved a rare issue where the game would freeze after certain weapon attacks.
[*] ​Save Data Will Be Cleared: Please note that all save data will be cleared as part of this update. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

​Apologies for Bugs: We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by these bugs. If you encounter any issues, please report them in the community or email us at NakuKinoko@gmail.com.
[/list]
